elena: Heads-up — Private Deploy 2.5 is going GA on 2026-04-02. This release focuses on tenant credential hygiene and a tighter support approval flow for on-prem clusters. Main highlights:
- Ephemeral tenant keys (default TTL 30d) + automated rotation.
- Remote Support Approval Flow: engineers must request time-limited access via Console; customer can approve/deny; audit records exported to S3/ObjStore.
- Optional maintenance-exempt SLA flag for scheduled maintenance windows (requires signed PO/contract update).

Quick TL;DR for SEs & CSMs:
1) No forced migrations for existing customers — old long-lived keys remain valid for 90 days after GA unless the customer opts in immediately.
2) New customers created after GA will get ephemeral keys by default.
3) If a customer needs legacy behavior, enable "legacy-keys:true" in tenant config and record reason in support ticket.

Action items (internal):
- SEs: start outreach list this week for customers with BYO-key setups (carla will help).
- Docs: update migration guide + playbook (maya).
- Security: validate rotation design and attest (security-bot).
- Ops: rollout schedule and canary hosts (ops-bot).

Migration snippet customers can use (example):
```
# generate a short-lived tenant key (30d)
rwctl tenant-keys create --tenant TENANT_ID --ttl 30d --out key.json
# rotate in place (server will accept both during grace window)
rwctl tenant-keys rotate --tenant TENANT_ID --file key.json
```

Expected customer impact: low if they use the Redwood SDKs (we handle token refresh seamlessly). Integrations using static config files need a one-time swap; we estimate 15-30 minutes of downtime during key swap if customers do it manually.

Compliance notes: rotation + signed approval artifacts satisfy additional audit controls requested by several finance/reg customers. Security folks — we added HMAC-signed event blobs for export.

Rollout plan:
- 2026-03-29: internal canary (prod-like infra, subset of customers by consent)
- 2026-04-02: GA opt-in open to all (customers can opt-out)
- 2026-05-01: opt-out window ends; customers on legacy keys will be migrated with 30 days notice unless extended by contract.

Please surface any blockers this week. This thread will be the canonical rollout announcement and will be pinned in #announcements.

alex: Thanks — quick Q: what's the default key TTL if the customer sets nothing?
elena: Default 30d. We support 7d/30d/90d via tenant policy. Custom TTLs >90d require SOC approval.
sam: For on-prem customers with offline-only control planes, how does rotation work?
elena: For air-gapped installs we ship a rotation bundle (signed) they can apply via the admin CLI. No external egress required. We'll provide the signed artifact and verification steps.
carla: I'll start compiling the BYO-key customer list and reach out to top 20 this afternoon.
maya: Docs PR incoming — will add a migration checklist and sample playbooks. ETA EOD Friday.
security-bot: Security review scheduled for 2026-03-26 16:00 UTC. Please add any outstanding design notes to the review doc: https://go/rw-private-2-5-security-review
ops-bot: Canary rollout plan created and pinned: https://go/rw-canary-plan-1769999999. Patch window reserved 2026-03-29 02:00-06:00 UTC.
elena: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn. If anyone needs customer-facing commit language, DM me and I'll share a short blurb. :rocket:
